howto.text:
Play the first artboard: the header links switch between Home, Privacy and Support, and NL / EN switches the language. Every other artboard is the same component with fixed props (screen, lang, theme, size), so a change to Main shows everywhere.

Dashed outlines and [brackets] mark content Eric still has to supply.

brief.text:
BRIEF (round 2)

Who: people who want to know who Eric is and what he makes, people who arrive from an app, the App Store or a privacy link, and Apple review.
Outcome: in ten seconds they know who Eric is, what he does and makes, and reach an app, the shared privacy policy, support, the account or a way to contact him.
Platforms: web only (static site on appelent.nl, www redirects to the apex). Dutch first, English second, light and dark following the OS.

Pages: / (personal showcase + apps), /privacy (one policy for all apps), /support (shared), /account (redirect to account.appelent.nl), 404. English under /en/…

Out of scope: the account portal itself (APP-481).

decisions.text:
DESIGN CHOICES

1. New AppElent design system from the icon: slate tile, chalk A, teal dot. Bricolage Grotesque + Inter.
2. Round 2 (Eric, 20 Nov): the home page is a personal showcase. Order: hero (photo, name, who you are) → What I do → What I make (the four apps) → one-account band → What I build with → Contact.
3. Round 2 (Eric, 20 Nov): one shared privacy policy on appelent.nl/privacy with a section per app (#app-gather etc.). The apps' own /privacy pages redirect there; support is shared too.
4. Each app keeps its own colour in its icon only; cards stay neutral.
5. App Store badge per app; not-yet-public apps show a dashed 'Binnenkort' badge.
6. NL / EN switch in the header; / follows Accept-Language on first visit.
7. Old repo appelent-homepage holds only a README: nothing to keep.

open.text:
WHAT ERIC STILL SUPPLIES

A. A photo (square, at least 400 px).
B. One or two sentences about yourself (hero).
C. Your work: what you do by day or next to AppElent (third card).
D. Contact: which email address on the site, and LinkedIn or other links (or none).
E. App Store status at launch per app (drawn: Arcade Club 'Binnenkort').
F. Privacy: the final text is merged from the four app policies at build time; Eric approves it in the PR.
